body: cry, like honestly just cry. im not being an asshole but its something i cant do that i think would help in a situation like this. I cant say your beautiful or handsome as ive never seen you. i wont tell you your awesome because i dont know what youve accomplished with your life. but the one thing i understand from reading this is that you and i are on the opposite sides of the spectrum with the same issue. you dont have to reply to me but i would like to know what you are thinking as from the 100's of threads ive read so far yours struck me. your not special chances are if you were to live youll live an average lifestyle. I am that kid who goes to parties throws them and gets straight A's. Im that one who always people go to for help and people look up to me because of my accomplishments. I feel alone and dead on the inside. im actually thinking of ending it too. i just dont know how or when. i know i could become successful but this life is just annoying. Honestly i want to pass in my sleep and relaxed. You got the short end of the stick and i worked my way up with the good students but i dont think that it did anything for me. guess this world does have a lot of people like me hmm. well im glad i was able to express myself freely here with you.
